what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Colombia in Italy: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 6517 Colombian asylum seekers in Italy, 2.1% of all asylum seekers from Colombia.
Refugees from Colombia, a separate group, live mostly in Ecuador, Venezuela, Canada and Costa Rica.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Colombia in every year from 2005 to 2025, with the ELN and FARC groups among the opponents.
The main years of displacement in the data, 2024 and 2025, fall within that conflict.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2010 at 19 asylum seekers.
The figure is at its highest at the end of 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Italy.
Asylum seekers are counted separately from refugees, as year-end totals for Italy only.
